data.gender_notes: Nazindah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful, elegant and adorned one, derived from the Arabic roots 'naz' (adorn) and 'dah' (given). The name Nazindah carries the meaning “Graceful adornment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazindah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful adornment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
